about: Usernames and e-mail domains the system creates accounts with: the admin and the venue hosts of server/src/seed.js, the import hosts of server/src/import/sources.js.

Nobody else may take them: sign-up and profile changes (Laravel), the e-mail change (Laravel) and the admin rename (Node) refuse them, compared without regard to case. Otherwise someone could register the admin's username or a host's address before the seed runs and be adopted by it.

server/test/reserved-accounts.test.js fails when the seed or the import creates a username or uses a domain that is not listed here. Which further names to reserve (support, team, brand names) is the operator's decision; only the system's own are listed.
